eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 29 · SQL Server Agent & Automation

code:
SELECT j.name, h.step_id, h.step_name,
    msdb.dbo.agent_datetime(h.run_date, h.run_time)
        AS run_datetime,
    h.message
FROM msdb.dbo.sysjobs AS j
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobhistory AS h
    ON j.job_id = h.job_id
WHERE h.run_status = 0 AND h.step_id <> 0;
caption: Drop the step_id = 0 filter to see which step failed.

code:
JOIN msdb.dbo.sysjobsteps AS s
    ON h.job_id = s.job_id
   AND h.step_id = s.step_id

SELECT j.name, h.step_name, s.command, h.message
caption: sysjobsteps.command shows exactly what ran.
